source_pdf: Chapter 02 Meat And Edible Meat Offal.pdf
extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '02011000'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '0201.10.00') per project schema. 6-digit subheading numbers (e.g., '020110') normalized to NNNN.NN (e.g., '0201.10'). Heading codes (e.g., '0201') are 4-digit.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Sl.No. Notes Notification No Notification Date', 'SI.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition', 'Main Notes', 'Supplementary Notes', 'Policy Condition', 'Export Licensing Notes', 'Product Description and Export Policy') were recognized as table headers and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Section I Main Notes (pre-chapter) contain 2 notes: (1) reference to young of genus/species, and (2) definition of 'dried' as including dehydrated/evaporated/freeze-dried products. These are captured in section_notes.

Chapter 02 has a single Main Note (SI.No. 1) which is a 'This Chapter does not cover' exclusion clause with sub-items (a), (b), (c), (d). Each sub-item is captured as a separate row in exclusion_clauses per project schema.

Two distinct Supplementary Notes tables appear in the PDF. The first (page 2, immediately after Main Notes) contains 1 entry defining 'wild animal' under Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 — captured in subheading_notes. The second Supplementary Notes table (page 4) contains 8 entries: items 1-2 are sub-heading definitions ('Beef includes meat and edible offal of cows, oxens and calf' and 'Offal includes heart, liver, tongue, kidneys and other organs') captured in subheading_notes; items 3-8 are restatements/cross-references of Policy Conditions 1-6 (with minor textual variations such as 'Restricted Export authorisation' vs 'restricted export authorisation..' and case differences) — these are NOT re-captured in subheading_notes to avoid duplication; the canonical text is preserved in policy_conditions.

Policy Conditions table contains 8 numbered conditions covering: (1) chilled/frozen meat veterinary certification, (2) canned meat pre-shipment inspection, (3) gonads/reproductive organs/germplasm restricted authorisation, (4) APEDA declaration requirement, (5) carton labeling requirements, (6) State veterinary certification, (7) Wild Life (Protection) Act prohibition on wild animal exports, (8) Halal certification scheme (I-CAS Halal) for 15 listed countries.

Policy Condition 8 (Halal) contains '?' characters in place of typographic quote marks ('?India Conformity Assessment Scheme(I-CAS)- Halal?', 'importing country?s requirements'). These are OCR/encoding artifacts from the source PDF — preserved verbatim. Intended text uses curly quotes around 'India Conformity Assessment Scheme(I-CAS)- Halal' and an apostrophe in 'country's'.

The 'Export Licensing Notes' header appears at the bottom of page 3 immediately after Policy Condition 8 but is followed only by the Supplementary Notes table on page 4 and then the tariff table — no Export Licensing Notes content rows are present in this chapter. The header is preserved as a table-chrome artifact and no export_licensing_notes field is populated.

Source PDF contains minor spelling/typo artifacts preserved verbatim: 'POUTRY' (heading 0209, should be 'POULTRY'), 'oxens' (Supp Note 1, should be 'oxen'), 'Conition' (Policy Condition references, should be 'Condition'), 'dolphines' (subheading 0208.40, should be 'dolphins'), 'authorisation..' (with double period, Supp Note 5).

Heading 0205 (Meat of horses, asses, mules or hinnies, fresh, chilled or frozen) appears in the PDF only as the 8-digit tariff line '02050000' with no separate 4-digit heading row. The heading title is reconstructed from the tariff line description per ITC(HS) convention; tariff line is attached directly under the heading.

Subheading 0206.80 (Other, fresh or chilled) and 0206.90 (Other, frozen) appear with the 6-digit code in the PDF (020680, 020690). Subheading 0210.20 ('Meat of bovine animals') appears as an 8-digit code 02102000 — preserved as the single tariff line '0210.20.00' under subheading '0210.20'.

Subheading 0210.99 ('Of primates' for tariff line 02109200 area) — the PDF row '02109100' uses description 'Other, including edible flours and meals of meat or meat offal' and on the next page shows ': -- Of primates' as a continuation/orphan row without a tariff line code. This appears to be a layout artifact where '-- Of primates' is the sub-description fragment of 0210.91 in the source. Captured verbatim under 0210.91 tariff line.

All tariff lines under headings 0204, 0206 (selected), 0207 partial, 0208, 0209, and 0210 are shown with Notification No '34/2024-25' dated '01.10.2024' in the Policy Condition column. Many of these tariff-line-specific Policy Condition cells contain text like 'Quality control and inspection under Policy Conition 1 and 2 respectively as well as Policy Condition 4 are required to be fulfilled. Exports shall also be subject to Policy Condition 8 of this Chapter.' — these reference the chapter-level Policy Conditions and are not re-captured per tariff line in this extraction. The canonical Policy Conditions are in policy_conditions.

Tariff line 0210.20.00 (Meat of bovine animals, salted/in brine/dried/smoked) carries a tariff-line-specific Policy Condition restating Policy Conditions 1, 2, 4, 6 with the same buffalo-not-for-breeding-and-milch-purposes condition. This is preserved as a chapter-wide pattern via policy_conditions; the per-tariff-line restatement is not duplicated here.

section_notes.text: Any reference in this Section to a particular genus or species of an animal, except where the context otherwise requires, includes a reference to the young of that genus or species.
Except where the context otherwise requires, throughout this Schedule, any reference to "dried" products also covers products which have been dehydrated, evaporated or freeze-dried.

chapter_subheading_notes.text: In this Chapter, "wild animal" means wild animal as defined in the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 (53 of 1972).
Beef includes meat and edible offal of cows, oxens and calf.
Offal includes heart, liver, tongue, kidneys and other organs.
